content: <thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak is at m/z 235.1395. Assuming it is the [M+H]⁺ ion, the neutral mass is ≈ 234.132 Da. The isotopic pattern shows an M+1 intensity of ~16 % (≈ 15 C atoms) and an M+2 intensity of ~4–5 % (consistent with one sulfur atom). A formula that matches the exact mass and isotopic pattern is C₁₄H₁₈OS (neutral monoisotopic mass = 234.1078 Da; [M+H]⁺ = 235.1151 Da, within experimental error). Therefore the molecular formula in the required format is C14H18O1S.
